function navBurgerCanvas(host, label): HTMLCanvasElement;

Defined in: website/components/nav/menu.tsx:64

The burger icon's canvas element — lazily created once and kept for the component's lifetime so its WebGL context is never churned by re-renders (canvas recreation would force a fresh GL context). Each call also re-syncs the on-dark class and aria-label/expanded since those change without recreating the element.

Parameters

host

NavMenuHost

AppNav instance.

label

string

aria-label for the burger (localized "menu").
